query: WITH earliest_gosi AS ( SELECT id, MIN(CAST(job_start_date AS DATE)) AS first_gosi_date FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala WHERE CAST(id AS STRING) LIKE '1%' AND job_sector = 'خاص' GROUP BY id )  SELECT COUNT(*) AS saudis_first_gosi_2022  FROM earliest_gosi  WHERE YEAR(first_gosi_date) = 2022 LIMIT 1200
raw_question: كم عدد السعوديين الذين دخلوا سوق العمل لأول مرة في القطاع الخاص في عام 2022؟
